sources.entry: MintHCM - Tool for Human Capital Management based on two popular, well-known business applications SugarCRM Community Edition and SuiteCRM. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: MintHCM is an open-source, AI-native human capital management (HR) platform built on SugarCRM Community Edition and SuiteCRM code.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes MintHCM as an HR system covering recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, employee profiles and employment history, skills and evaluations, time and attendance, leave management, performance and development, organizational structure, job descriptions, resource booking, and reporting. It claims a native MCP/A2A/WebMCP architecture and a built-in AI agent, with support for custom agents and any LLM provider. It offers an open API, modular architecture, and custom workflows, and it states that the API is similar to SuiteCRM's with some differences documented separately. The README also mentions iOS and Android mobile apps and translations managed through Crowdin. Installation is covered by an external guide, and the README gives no install commands.
use_cases: build custom HR workflows with AI agents
run self-hosted HR on own infrastructure
how_to_run: See the installation guide at minthcm.org/support/minthcm-installation-guide/ (not included in the README)
notable: Built on SugarCRM CE and SuiteCRM code, with an API similar to SuiteCRM's
Native MCP, WebMCP and A2A agent architecture, with a built-in AI agent
LLM-agnostic: claims support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, local Llama and others
Deployable on-prem, in public or private cloud, or hybrid
Translations managed through a Crowdin project
caveats: Requires Linux or Windows with Apache2, PHP 8.2, a MySQL or MariaDB database, and ElasticSearch 7.10+, which makes setup non-trivial
Installation and API details are delegated to external guides rather than the README
keywords: share hr data with ai agents
run hr system on my own server
